name: Nikita Satsiuk
headline: AI-native full-stack developer — TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL
description: I build web products end to end: database schema, backend, frontend, mobile app, deployment. My main product is bloomly.by, a flower-subscription marketplace I designed and shipped alone — 65 PostgreSQL tables, card acquiring with idempotent payment handling, a Next.js web app and a React Native mobile app. I work with AI agents as a professional tool: I set the architecture and the module boundaries, and every result that matters is verified by a second, independent computation.

experiences.summary: Flower-subscription marketplace bloomly.by. Sole developer: architecture, database, backend, frontend, mobile app, deployment and support.
achievements: Designed a PostgreSQL schema of 65 tables with 83 idempotent migrations, 136 indexes and 70 PL/pgSQL functions; money logic lives in the database, not in application code.
Built the payment core as a PL/pgSQL state machine with row locking and idempotency keys, so a replayed bank webhook cannot settle an order twice.
Integrated Alfa-Bank card acquiring and the national ERIP system: order registration, status reconciliation, refunds, merchant payouts, HMAC webhook signature verification.
Shipped a Next.js 16 web app — 84 pages, 184 Server Actions, three isolated dashboards — and a React Native app with 47 screens.
Ran six security review cycles: column-level privilege separation, hardening of money paths, an XSS fix in a WebView-rendered template.

experiences.summary: Sites and web applications for small business: markup, server side, domain, deployment and support — the whole project owned by one person.
achievements: Built a bilingual corporate site for a wholesale fruit supplier on Next.js with next-intl: hreflang and canonical tags, static generation of both locales, 209 translation keys at full parity.
Automated an outbound sales pipeline: per-prospect offer page generator, outreach over the Telegram MTProto protocol, publishing to GitHub Pages.
